mapper.update: UPDATE t_file_upload SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_file_upload WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM t_file_upload WHERE stored_filename = #{storedFilename} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM t_file_upload WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY upload_time DESC
SELECT * FROM t_file_upload WHERE file_type LIKE CONCAT(#{fileType}, '%') AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY upload_time DESC
SELECT * FROM t_file_upload WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY upload_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_file_upload SET download_count = download_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_file_upload WHERE is_deleted = 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(file_size), 0) FROM t_file_upload WHERE is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM t_file_upload WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND DATE(upload_time) BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} ORDER BY upload_time DESC
SELECT * FROM t_file_upload WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND ( original_filename LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY upload_time DESC
SELECT * FROM t_file_upload WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY upload_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
